meta.title: Ondra Rebrand and Re-sign
meta.description: A map of where the product name lives, plus the inside-out re-signing spec. The display name has one source in product-name.mjs; the About panel and the menu copy in eight languages each hold a copy, and the development bundle still hard-codes the upstream name Harness Dev. The plan orders the work from the innermost nested code outwards, and seven invariants guard what must not move: changing the bundle id is effectively shipping a different application, changing the URL scheme breaks every deep link already published, letting the userData path follow the name orphans the previous profile on every rename, release builds must not be signed with codesign deep, a re-sign must carry the entitlements plus a secure timestamp and the runtime option, and swapping the icon means also editing the plist key that points at it. It performs no signing itself: the upstream repository already owns the codesign arguments, the identity assertions, the notarization checks and the electron-builder identity, sign-ignore and after-sign verification, so this package is a thin wrapper that adds the map, the ordering, the audit and a translation of signature output into structured findings rather than a rewrite of any signing command. The audit consumes bundle facts supplied by the caller instead of reading the application bundle: parsing a plist means a second format parser and reading a signature means executing an external tool, and neither belongs in a plugin process. The display name defaults to empty because the truth lives on that one upstream line and a copy here would be a second source; while it is empty the plan offers only the step that declares a name, and no name is invented on the user's behalf.
